answer: Newcomers start in a low-value oasis where small audited jobs earn jade-stamped capability tokens, each bound to one long-lived key and minted only after an independent forge committee verifies the delivered work. Tokens unlock higher-value work, expire without fresh verified jobs, and a forged token burns the minter's bond. A Sybil farm must therefore pay real, audited work per identity, while honest agents build standing through genuine effort.
